value.text: Springfield Fall 2026 swim lessons open Tuesday, September 15 at 7:00 a.m. for residents, and the general public opens 7 days later. Max fits the published age band and Mia is just outside it, so check that Mia's class is right for her before you sign up. Once you pick a course, send me the link to its page and I'll carry it into the morning text. Here is the registration page: https://rec.example.org/springfield/fall-2026. Here is what I'll send you: a week-ahead note 7 days before, a checklist 3 days before, a reminder the evening before, and a last nudge 15 minutes before it opens. I never register for you, so you'll still need to log in and sign up yourself. Approve below if you want me to run this.
